title: The BTB transcription factors ZBTB11 and ZFP131 maintain pluripotency by repressing pro-differentiation genes
contrast: Day 12 vs plasmid pool (1 vs 1; no-replicate path)
paper_calls: 196 high-confidence depleted TFs (3 methods); ZBTB11, ZFP131 the validated hits
barcs_calls: 313 genes at FDR 0.10 after control calibration
verdict: BARCS depletes both validated pluripotency TFs (ZBTB11, ZFP131) and correlates with the paper's MAGeCK ranks (Spearman 0.70, top-300 Jaccard 0.99).
